journey.name: Sigil-less launch
journey.description:
A fresh install, before any sigil is forged, must reach a usable board screen and stay there.
This is a regression test for a trap found on a real device: SessionLock locked a session with no sigil, and the only control on that screen was an unlock that called ensureSeedReady, which throws SigilRequiredException every time when no sigil exists. The screen said "Authentication didn't complete - tap to try again", inviting a retry that could never succeed, and the only escape was force-stopping the app. Fixed in SessionLock by declining to lock a session that has no seed to protect; this journey is what stops it coming back.

actions.action: Verify the screen does NOT show "LOCKED"
Verify the screen does NOT show "Authentication didn't complete"
Verify the screen shows a "CREATE A NEW BOARD" control
Verify the screen shows a "CONNECT" control
